== Biography ==

Edward was born on 28 January 1859 at 15 Davisons Yard, Middlesbrough, Yorkshire.  His father was a Puddler in the Iron Works called Samuel Fisher and his mother was born Prudence Love.<ref>
'''"FreeBMD GRO Birth Index,"''' database with images, ''FreeBMD'' ( https://www.freebmd.org.uk/cgi/information.pl?cite=q1Zny6dG354mHruKkSx%2FiQ&scan=1 : 28-Jul-2024),
Edward Fisher, 1859, quarter 1, vol. 10a, p. 33, Stockton, Durham, England,
citing General Register Office, Southport, England.
</ref>

On 14 July, 1880, he married Fanny Fisher by certificate at the register office in Middlesbrough. She was 24 years old, without an occupation, and the Widow of Joseph Fisher who was Edward's elder brother. Edward was a 20 year old bachelor working as a Clerk.  They were both living at 9 Unthank Street, Linthorpe, Middlesbrough at the time of their marriage.<ref>
'''"FreeBMD GRO Marriage Index,"''', database with images, ''FreeBMD'' (https://www.freebmd.org.uk/cgi/information.pl?cite=onUBt2yoqzuQD%2BHceV8OcA&scan=1 : 28-Jul-2024),
Edward Fisher, 1880, quarter 3, district. Middlesbro, vol. 9d, p. 734,
citing General Register Office, Southport, England.
</ref>

Edward died from Carcinomia of the stomach (Cancer) on 19 October 1939 whilst living at 12 Carr Street, Stockton-on-Tees. He was 80 years old and worked as a Painter at the Engineering Works.<ref>
'''"FreeBMD GRO Death Index,"''', database with images, ''FreeBMD'' (https://www.freebmd.org.uk/cgi/information.pl?cite=mdharx4ZOKy1xj9uFq%2FH2g&scan=1 : 28-Jul-2024),
Edward Fisher, Age. 80, 1939, quarter. 4, district. Durham S E, Vol. 10a, Page. 85;
citing General Register Office, Southport, England.
</ref>
